name: MIPA Summer Journalism Workshop (MSU)
org: Michigan Interscholastic Press Association (MIPA), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend five days on the MSU campus with expert teachers. You build news skills like writing, photos, design, yearbook and news anchoring.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 7 to 12 in the fall.
pay_detail: Fee not stated on the page read. Scholarships and fundraising help are available.
deadline_text: Dates for the next workshop are not shown on the page read.
how_to_apply: Use the registration link on the MIPA program page. Phone 517-353-6761, email ask@mipamsu.org.
